Turner3856 *khasati gives Prakrit khasai, Nepali khasnu, Maithili khasab and Hindi khasna fall/slip. Dhakal p52 contrasts kəsike tighten with kʰəsike fall down, verifying initial aspiration and the unextended khas- stem. The infinitive -ike is documented in p75. No -kk-, -ḍ- or -r- extension is present. Darai grazing and falling verbs; primary evidence checked; no rebuild.
